content:
The Laredo Housing Authority will begin accepting pre-applications for housing assistance on Thursday, November 12.

Pre-applications will be accepted from 8:30 to 11:30 a.m. and must be submitted in person at 2000 San Francisco Avenue in Laredo. The Authority says it will keep accepting pre-applications until further notice.

The opening covers the Low Rent Elderly program, for seniors only. Two-bedroom units are available at 3119 Seymour Circle in Laredo.

Applicants will be placed on a waiting list in the order their pre-applications are received. Pre-applications are available in accessible formats on request, and reasonable accommodations can be arranged by calling (956) 764-9396.

Source: Laredo Housing Authority, November 9, 2026.

title: Laredo Housing Authority opens pre-applications for senior housing assistance
